resources.string: HeyBroc uses the AccessibilityService API only to read the visible product title and ingredient text shown in Walmart, Instacart, Target, Kroger, ALDI, DoorDash, Uber Eats, Amazon Fresh, Sam\'s Club, BJ\'s, Costco, and Shipt and send it over HTTPS to heybroc.com to compute your 0–100 ingredient score. No other apps or personal data are read, stored, or sold.
